headline: Ocean-freight stress is ELEVATED and easing — 20.9/100; Strait of Hormuz is the lead driver, -62% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **20.9/100** (**elevated**), down 10.8 pts week-over-week. 2 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Strait of Hormuz**, running **27.0/day** vs a normal of **71.0/day** (-62%).
**308** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Also moving now: **Bosporus Strait** is running **36% below** normal.
Market context: Brent crude **$71.59/bbl** (+2.04% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$305.0M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$980K** cost-of-delay ($546K–$1.6M).
